profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Recent CS graduate with seven years experience on the business-side of software development. As a product planning manager, I had the opportunity to work through all phases of the development cycle – negotiating and defining requirements, providing customer input and brainstorming design ideas with engineering, clarifying and prioritizing bugs, and providing training and materials for launch. Throughout my career I have used my love of technology to improve business processes and go beyond what was expected for my role. I have always been drawn toward the development side of software projects and am so excited to follow this passion and work full-time as a software developer.

GPA: 4.0
Languages: C/C++/C#, Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, jQuery, MySQL, CSS, HTML

Highlights:
• 7 years product management experience, working closely with engineering and leading the definition of successful firmware products to global enterprise customers
• Proven self-starter and creative problem solver with ability to learn new technologies and tools very quickly
• Strong team player with communication skills to effectively work with management, engineering, sales, and customers
• Experienced in software development projects with global, cross-functional teams using Agile and Waterfall methodologies
• Demonstrated engineering talent through contributions to user interface designs and XML/SOAP message definitions

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Project: Universal Windows Platform app for IoT device (C#, XAML) 
• Designed and implemented multi-page user interface, leveraging ribbon and chart controls from DevExpress 
• Created application architecture using MVVM pattern and developing classes for ViewModel and spectrometer data handling 
• Implemented data binding between XAML elements and ViewModel objects; developed custom converters for boolean and enum values 
• Implemented asynchronous spectrometer data reading using tasks and events

positions.title: Parental Leave / Student / Technical Writer
positions.description:
Provided full-time care to my two children until they were both in elementary school in Fall 2016. During this time I found numerous opportunities to maintain and build my skills:
•	Completed second bachelor's degree in Computer Science at Oregon State University
•	Contract technical writing including white papers and user guides for desktop, web and mobile software
•	Volunteered as classroom assistant, yearbook photographer, and youth basketball coach

positions.title: Product Planning Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for requirements analysis and definition for embedded firmware on Sharp multifunction peripherals. "Go-to-person" for Sharp OSA project, a web services-based API that won BERTL's "2008 Best Development Platform" award. Responsibilities included:
•	Analyzed market and industry trends to develop product vision and roadmaps
•	Identified product requirements via customer research, collaboration with global subsidiaries, and competitive benchmarking
•	Contributed to Sharp's intellectual property with 11 issued US patents
•	Developed detailed product specifications and negotiated requirements with engineering and sales teams. Repurposed information into multiple formats for different audiences - from high-level market-focused presentations for management to detailed technical documents for engineering
•	Managed product requirements throughout the development life cycle - clarifying requirements, providing customer input and brainstorming design ideas with engineering team, and negotiating feature trade-offs
•	Supported product launches through train-the-trainer sessions, competitive comparisons, white papers, and escalated support

positions.title: Family Business
positions.description:
I have worked at my family’s berry farm since I was a child and it has given me invaluable experience in understanding how a business works and the work ethic required to be successful.
• Converted company’s paper-based accounting to QuickBooks
• Took on any task necessary to ensure success of the business including reception, employee scheduling, managing employees, computer work, payroll and accounting, working on harvesters and cannery line, and driving harvesters and tractors

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Work study position to update and create new pages for the SCU external web site

positions.title: Marketing Intern and Web Designer
positions.description:
•	Designed and maintained web site using Macromedia Dreamweaver and Adobe Photoshop
•	Created company portfolio for business presentations
•	Developed tradeshow/event analysis
•	Researched a market niche for product positioning

positions.title: Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
• Implemented system for tradeshow follow-ups to reduce response time by creating database files in Access, form letters in Word, and macros in Word to insert product information
• Revamped monthly sales reports to include more useful information in easier-to-read format by rewriting reports in MAS90 and writing macros in Excel
• Designed and coordinated direct mailings from start to finish: writing reports to create mail list, designing and writing mail piece, ordering supplies, and assembling
• Created PowerPoint presentations for use in lectures at national and international tradeshows

projects.title: FairShare
projects.description:
Volunteer Project: Franciscan Montessori Earth School

A Ruby on Rails app that allows parents to submit and track their volunteer hours at a local Montessori school. Learning existing MVC application and contributing bug fixes, primarily in the View code.

projects.title: HowTo: Galleria
projects.description:
Class Project: Web Development – Spring 2014

A step-by-step introduction to using and customizing Galleria, a JavaScript framework for image galleries.
